Method of Attack: Overwrites the hard drive MBR (Master Boot Record) with a custom boot routine that prevents the computer from booting
Downloads and runs a malicious EXE binary that rewrites the MBR with a custom message
Attack Vector: Distributed as source code of a CS:GO hacking application
Execution of a PowerShell command from the .csproj file that downloads and runs the malicious EXE
Indicators of Compromise: Custom MBR boot message referencing MPGH
